_why: 0.2 mm layers to match the layer counts in the script (sieve plate and rotor 6 layers, follower 6 layers). 3 wall loops so the 2.25 mm hopper wall is pure perimeters. Every part prints flat or standing with 45 degree undersides only: no supports. The rod lies on its flat side, so it needs no brim. 15% infill. PETG for the spring, rotor and rod; food-safe PETG or PLA for the rest.
